title: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2608.21036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The transport of dangerous goods by sea is a high-consequence activity governed by the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, a complex regulatory framework where errors in classification, packaging, stowage, or segregation can result in fire, explosion, toxic release, or loss of life or vessel. Correct compliance requires accurately interpreting hundreds of pages of interacting provisions, updated on a two-year amendment cycle. Practitioners increasingly use Large Language Models (LLMs) as decision-support tools, yet no systematic evaluation exists of whether they can reliably interpret IMDG requirements for safety-critical use.   This paper introduces DGEval, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM knowledge of IMDG Amendment 42-24. translated_title: 评估大语言模型在国际海运危险货物规则合规方面的表现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21036v1 公告类型：新 摘要：海上危险货物运输是一项高后果活动，受《国际海运危险货物规则》（IMDG）这一复杂监管框架的约束，其中分类、包装、积载或隔离方面的错误可能导致火灾、爆炸、有毒物质释放或人员与船舶损失。正确合规需要准确解读数百页相互关联的条款，且每两年更新一次修正周期。从业者越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLMs）作为决策支持工具，但目前尚无系统性评估来检验它们能否可靠地解读IMDG要求以用于安全关键用途。本文介绍了DGEval，这是首个用于评估LLM对IMDG第42-24修正案知识的基准。该基准基于NCB Hazcheck电子学习平台上的专家编写问题以及危险货物清单（DGL）的结构化查询构建，包含1,678个问题，涵盖多项选择、开放式问题等类型。
tldr: 本文首次提出DGEval基准，系统评估大语言模型在国际海运危险货物规则合规中的表现，涵盖1,678个专家编写问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DGEval, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code compliance, comprising 1,678 expert-written questions.
